name: Arrows
description: A set of normal arrows used with a bow. Ideal for attacking enemies from a distance and activating mechanisms.

name: Deku Nuts
description: Special nuts that can be thrown at enemies to temporarily stun them.

name: Bombs
description: Explosive devices capable of destroying rocks and obstacles and damaging nearby enemies.

name: Bombchus
description: Small rodent-shaped explosives that travel along the ground toward their target before exploding.

name: Deku Shield
description: A lightweight shield made of wood. It provides basic protection and is especially useful during the early stages of an adventure.

name: Hylian Shield
description: A sturdy shield used by the soldiers of Hyrule. It provides greater protection than the Deku Shield.

name: Red Potion
description: A healing potion that restores the user's health.

name: Green Potion
description: A potion that restores the user's magic power, allowing magical abilities and items to be used.

name: Bottle
description: An empty bottle that can be used to store potions, fairies, milk and other special items.

name: Kokiri Sword
description: The traditional sword of the Kokiri. It is light, easy to handle and perfect for beginning an adventure.

name: Biggoron Sword
description: A massive sword forged by the legendary blacksmith Biggoron. Its great size provides tremendous attack power, but it requires both hands to wield.

name: Bomb Bag
description: A special bag used to carry and store bombs. It allows adventurers to carry explosives safely during their journey.
